:::{#exr-cross-entropy-numeric-entropy}

#### Entropy of a random variable with a given mass function

Let $X$ have [probability mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p = (\tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ on $\set{1, 2, 3}$.
Compute the [entropy](#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$ in bits from its definition.
Compare it with your value of $H(p, p)$ from @exr-cross-entropy-numeric-self.

:::
